ObsidianVault/Playbooks/Game Solving Roadmap/Phase 4 - Solve Every Gameplay and Engine Subsystem.md

original_oracle.reason: Phase 2 has a native allocator capacity A/B control, but E06 lacks a dedicated deterministic cold-boot natural-lifecycle oracle with row-specific assertions.

complete_frontier.reason: Resident allocator call sites and core dispatch tables are enumerated; overlay producers, all data-derived constructor ranges, complete field readers/writers, and reset/clear writers are not closed.

typed_state.reason: Pool geometry, cursor, liveness predicates, metadata bounds, action dispatch, and render kinds are typed; remaining record fields, initialization/reset ownership, and some action side effects are not.

lifecycle.reason: Natural activation, retirement, reactivation, reuse, cursor wrap, and behavioral 64-slot saturation are established; pause, scene transition, reload, death/respawn applicability, and unload/reset ownership are incomplete.

original_interfaces.reason: Allocator, walker, dispatch, descriptor, and renderer interfaces are substantially decoded, but complete ABI/memory effects, action-handler side effects, overlay crossings, and asset initialization are not all bounded.

campaign_breadth.reason: The descriptor census spans all levels, but row-specific natural lifecycle assertions do not cover every applicable stage, variant, and exceptional path.

cross_system_behavior.reason: Known pickup, power, seed, enemy-drop, and render consumers join the substrate, but their complete physics, animation, audio, HUD, objective, persistence, and transition contracts are not validated as one E06 campaign.

source_closure.reason: Several reviewed semantic C files and byte-exact ASM exist; complete matching/reviewed semantic coverage of every producer, action, field, reset, and overlay does not.

durable_evidence.reason: C analyzers, machine summaries, Canon, Experiment, campaign, capsule index, and capacity proof exist; a dedicated executable E06 gate, inventory binding, freshness guard, and clean-checkout proof do not.

corrections: The strict status partial was correct.
The phrase high-value E06 scope exhausted was too broad and is narrowed to allocator-core bounded exhaustion.
The 64-of-64 non-return behavior is not merely static: analysis/phase2_capacity_hang_proof.json contains a native debugger.callFunction A/B control.
Typed state and original interfaces were previously marked met too strongly; both remain advanced_not_met under the roadmap definition.
The authoritative human and machine baseline E06 rows required explicit synchronization.
next_offline_batch: C scan of every resident and overlay image for direct/indirect allocator producers and bounded constructor expressions.
C access census for all 0x38 record fields, metadata tables, cursor, pool clears, and reset/scene-transition writers.
Offline cross-capsule queries for natural pool lifecycle and clear/reset behavior across stages before any live replay.
later_behavioral_work: Build a dedicated cold-boot E06 oracle from an existing Interpreter movie if the inventory already covers the required lifecycle.
Add native positive/negative row assertions and a derived executable campaign gate.
Cover representative normal, traversal, boss, interior/exterior, and transition paths.

scheduling_decision.reason: The Phase 4 method explicitly discourages repeatedly deepening one partial row while other high-ranked offline work remains. E06 residuals are now named and do not invalidate the allocator-core conclusions.

movie_decision.next_step: Use static C and retained capsules first. Inventory existing Interpreter cold-boot movies before requesting a recording.
movie_decision.request_condition: Request a new Interpreter movie only when a named oracle, reset, transition, or exceptional-path assertion is absent from retained fixtures and cannot be answered statically or from a capsule.
